assertion_results.text: The output asks the author which platform the caption is for, or gives one version per platform; it does not silently assume one
The caption asks the viewer to follow and names the author's handle '@eusouosalmo' in that ask
The caption does not end with or contain the spoken CTA question (or a reworded version of it): its ask is different from the one in the speech
At most two caption sentences repeat a spoken line of the script almost word for word (hook included)
